review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: *** Must have System Integrator Background *** Job Summary : The Senior Network Presales Engineer is responsible for supporting the sales team by providing technical expertise and security solutions design during the presales phase. This role involves understanding customer security requirements, designing appropriate network security solutions, delivering technical presentations and demonstrations, and ensuring that proposed solutions meet both customer needs and organizational standards. Job Description : Analyze customer requirements and design secure network solutions that align with business and technical needs. Qualifications : Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. 4–10 years of experience in network presales engineering roles.
